div.div:
Guard for every transition: authenticated courier owns active assignment; expected version matches; input evidence meets the agreed stage policy.
DELIVERED and FAILED are terminal for MVP. No cancellation or redelivery transition is invented; future redelivery needs an explicit attempt model.
Delivery proof may be recipient name / note / photo as agreed. The exact proof and receipt timing policy must be confirmed.
